comment: Что агенты знают о быте и местах — для бытовых вопросов («хочу есть», «где вода», «где астролябия»). По зоне сцены. Только то, что есть в игре (квесты, предметы, реплики NPC).
ship: Food: the cook at the fire box hands out the ration: ship's biscuit, beans and salted sardines. Hungry sailors go to the cook.
Drink: fresh water is kept in barrels below deck and is rationed. There is a wineskin and a wine barrel on deck; sailors drink wine with their meals.
Money: nobody buys anything at sea. Sailors get their pay from the Crown after the voyage.
Sleep: the crew sleeps on the deck wherever there is room; only the Admiral has a cabin. You rest when your watch is over.
The sand glass stands at the stern. The ship's boy turns it each time the sand runs out, every half hour, and sings a short prayer. That is how the watches are kept.
The astrolabe is in the pilot's chest at the stern. With it the pilot measures the height of the noon sun to find our latitude.
The compass and the sea chart are used to check our heading west. A sword, an espingarda and a wineskin also lie about on deck.
The boatswain gives the orders on deck and decides who works and who rests. Old Juan is the oldest sailor on board. Gil plays the guitar.
canary: This is San Sebastián on La Gomera, in the Canary Islands. The fleet stops here for water, food and repairs before the open ocean.
Fresh water: the well is in the town. Empty barrels wait at the boat on the shore; fill them at the well and carry them back to the boat.
Food: the merchant Gonzalo at the market sells cheese, salted meat and biscuit for maravedís.
Repairs: the carpenter at the shipyard is fixing the rudder of the Pinta. He needs planks and tar, which lie at the shipyard.
Doña Beatriz de Bobadilla governs the island.
The boat on the shore takes everyone back to the ship when the work is done.
